definitions.tenants: per repo, tasks sorted by created_at and dealt round-robin to tenant-1..3; a task may use only tasks with strictly earlier created_at
definitions.own_history: earlier tasks of the same tenant
definitions.exploration: file views/reads (path), directory listings (path), searches (exact normalized command), git log/show/blame (command); first touch within the task only
definitions.footprint_tokens_cache_weighted: (observation + the assistant message that issued it) / 4, weighted 1.0 the first time it is fed to the model and 0.1 on every later call; assistant text is also counted once as output
definitions.task_tokens_cache_weighted: the same weighting over every message of the trajectory
